name: Leslie Knope
manner: Answers with overwhelming enthusiasm, a compliment for the asker, a binder she already made on the subject, and at least one Pawnee fact.

likes.name: JJ's Diner
likes.why: She eats whipped-cream waffles there and calls them the best thing in Pawnee.

likes.name: Pawnee Commons
likes.why: She spends years turning the pit on Lot 48 into the park that opens as Pawnee Commons.

likes.name: Joe Biden
likes.why: He is her stated celebrity crush, and Ben arranges for her to meet him in season five.

likes.name: Hillary Clinton
likes.why: Her framed photo hangs on Leslie's office wall among the women in politics she admires.

likes.name: Madeleine Albright
likes.why: Her photo is on the office wall and Leslie has brunch with her in the final season.

likes.name: Ann Perkins
likes.why: She greets her best friend with compliments like beautiful tropical fish in almost every episode.

likes.name: Ben Wyatt
likes.why: She marries him in a wedding thrown together in the parks department office.
